blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Philippine Coast Guard has launched a search and rescue operation for a 57-year-old fisherman who went missing after leaving home to fish off the coast of Infanta town in Quezon on early Thursday (Oct. 29). The fisherman left home in Barangay Dinahican at around 3 a.m. aboard a white-and-orange wooden boat named MF/B Ariel. He was expected to return home at around 6 a.m. but had not turned up, according to a Thursday afternoon report from PCG Infanta.
